<function name="SetMousePos" parent="gui" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
<deprecated>Use <page>input.SetCursorPos</page> instead.</deprecated>
Sets the cursor's position on the screen, relative to the topleft corner of the window
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="mouseX" type="number">The X coordinate to move the cursor to.</arg>
		<arg name="mouseY" type="number">The Y coordinate to move the cursor to.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
